title: A Prediction Model for Osteoporosis Risk Using a Machine-Learning Approach and Its Validation in a Large Cohort.
summary: XGBoost selected among seven models using 8,421 Ansan/Anseong participants and 80/20 train/test; selected model was applied to HEXA cohort. AUC reached .890 internally; fracture association in HEXA is indirect because that cohort lacked measured BMD.
